shared_elements: possible sign-like or script-like incised marks
justification: Both surfaces carry human figures and a circular disc-like motif combined with incised linear markings that read as sign-like, which is about as generic as such correspondences get. The depicted content otherwise diverges sharply: A is a single massive frontal body carved in the round, its torso bearing isolated curvilinear and ring motifs, whereas B is a flat panel showing a horizontal row of small standing figures confronting one another above many ruled lines of script — no shared specific posture, attribute or grouping.
